title: Network Controller
location: Singapore, Singapore
field: -
description:
[under: About the Position] Fugro Satellite Positioning, Inc. has an immediate opening in the Singapore office for a Network Controller.
[under: About the Position] This position is responsible for monitoring and proactively supporting the daily operation of our Fugro Data Network, including Network Control Center (NCC), Remote sites and Satellite uplink sites.
[under: Major Responsibilities] - Monitoring operation of the NCC (remote site data collection, central computer operation, data distribution and uplinking) and responding to data alarm conditions.
[under: Major Responsibilities] - Providing assistance during additions or changes to either the NCC or remote site computer and data communications equipment.
[under: Major Responsibilities] - Creating brief memos, emails and occasional drawings using established office software.
[under: Knowledge/Skill/Qualifications] - Good computer literacy and competence in the use of common office software packages like Windows and Red Hat operating systems
